The '''Tchuukthai homeworld''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tchuukthai]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which, although discovered multiple times, was generally assumed to be primitive and dangerous. The Tchuukthai carefully guarded the identity and location of their homeworld. Eventually, the Tchuukthai [[Thon]] departed the planet after meeting a [[Thon's Jedi Master|Jedi Master]], ultimately becoming a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] himself.

==Description==
The Tchuukthai homeworld<ref name="Wizards" /> was a terrestrial<ref name="WizardsTchuukthai" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located deep in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TOTJC" />

==History==
[[File:Tchuukthai.png|thumb|right|300px|The planet was the homeworld of the Tchuukthai species.]]
Over the span of several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], the planet's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tchuukthai]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were discovered more than once; however, [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] tended to presume they were dangerous, primitive beasts and avoided them. At one point, a [[Thon's Jedi Master|Jedi Master]] encountered the species. Befriending a Tchuukthai, [[Thon]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] explained to him much about [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and ultimately invited him to travel with him offworld and [[Jedi training/Legends|train]] as a Jedi, an offer that the Tchuukthai accepted. Initially, however, Thon was reluctant to leave his [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] and was concerned that the wider [[galactic community]] knowing the true nature of the Tchuukthai would result in the latter's exploitation, in response to which the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] swore that he would protect their secret.<ref name="Wizards" />

For [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], Thon, who himself became a Jedi Master, was the only Tchuukthai who had left the species' homeworld; it was possible that other Tchuukthai eventually followed suit, at times as pets or zoological exhibits. The species kept the identity and location of their homeworld a closely guarded secret, however.<ref name="Wizards" /> Information about both the Tchuukthai and their homeworld remained sparse and unreliable<ref name="TOTJC" /> by around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="4000 BBY">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' is set four thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which translates to approximately [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> and during the existence of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Wizards" /> between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the existence of the Tchuukthai was still considered only a rumor across most of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Wizards" />

==Inhabitants==
The Tchuukthai homeworld was home to the sentient, [[Limb/Legends|quadrupedal]]<ref name="Wizards" /> [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]]<ref name="CSWE Tchuukthai">{{CSWECite|III|226|Tchuukthai}}</ref> Tchuukthai species, members of which spoke the [[Tchuukthese]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet of origin of Thon and his species,<ref name="TOTJC" /> the Tchuukthai,<ref name="Wizards" /> was first mentioned in the [[1996]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', which was written by [[George R. Strayton]].<ref name="TOTJC" /> The world was subsequently referred to as the Tchuukthai homeworld in the [[April 10]], [[2003]] [[Wizards.com]] [https://web.archive.org/web/20090603072054/http://www.wizards.com/default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030410uaaweb Web Enhancement] for ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'',<ref name="Wizards" /> a [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook published in [[April]], 2003.<ref name="Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030403chrisperkins|text=''Ultimate Alien Anthology'' Interview}}</ref> The web supplement was written by [[J.D. Wiker]] and [[Christopher Perkins]].<ref name="Wizards" />
